unlisted_practices: Robust feature selection for predictive model development
Interpretable patient clustering and feature importance to improve clinical trust
Standards-based (FHIR-like) data exchange to minimize manual data entry for risk assessment

screen.reason: The study develops and retrospectively evaluates a machine learning risk prediction model for COVID-19 severe outcomes with an explicit focus on demographic fairness and interpretability, but does not test a health care organization deployment practice or safeguard.
